core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghanem corresponds to the Arabic form غانم (Arabic root غ ن م (gh-n-m); غانِم (Ghānim)). Its core sense is one who gains, acquires. Ghanem is Arabic غانم (Ghānim) 'one who gains, acquires; successful', the active participle of the root غ ن م (gh-n-m). The source gloss 'gracious, generous' belongs to a different root (ك ر م) and has been replaced.

faq.q: What is the origin of Ghanem?

Yes — the underlying form غانم is Arabic.

faq.q: What does Ghanem mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ghanem is rendered غانم and carries the sense بهره‌مند، به‌دست‌آورنده.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Ghanem, ghanem. Script forms are غانم, ग़ानिम.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
